plugin.name: CLODEx RP Studio
plugin.description: All-in-one roleplay companion powered by your CLODEx API key: AI Physiology, Custom Meters & Inventory Tracker (respiration, pulse, wounds, cycles, Omegaverse Pro, Oviposition & Nest), Cradle & Familiar (SFW familiars & 2nd-generation offspring with Nano Banana portraits, I2V video & TTS voice), Lore Navigator ("Biblical Mistral" / Dante / Card Lore), 1-Click CCv2 Character Forge, and Live Scene Backgrounds.
releaseNotes.1_1_0: v1.1.0 adds Character Voice TTS (/v1/audio/speech with dialogue-only filter), Custom Story Meters & Inventory builder with swipe rollback, and 1-Click Character & Lorebook Forge (CCv2 PNG card with embedded Lorebook + Nano Banana portrait).
releaseNotes.1_2_0: v1.2.0 introduces Cradle & Familiar (summon SFW familiars from Turn 1 or raise Family Tree offspring with Nano Banana stage portraits, I2V video loops, TTS voice reactions, and 1-click CCv2 2nd-generation card graduation), mobile single-row 4-tab layout, per-character voiceMap binding, and FinOps session auto-spend cap.

releaseNotes.1_3_0: v1.3.0 «Director & Living World»: one-turn Director strip above the input (suspense, twist, dialogue focus, slow pacing, NPC point of view, sensory details + your own 140-char note), local Anti-Slop radar in Codex → Style, hidden thoughts and 3 suggested actions under the last reply, Smartphone / Diary & World Feed with click-to-reveal photos and voice notes, Living Session Wiki (NPCs, quests, places, timeline) with pinned manual edits, branch-safe journals for swipes, and shareable data-only .clodex-pack presets. Zero extra API calls per turn; the role-play prompt addition stays under 250 tokens.
releaseNotes.1_3_1: v1.3.1 mobile Tavo WebView hotfix: fixed the drawer mask overriding the HTML [hidden] attribute (which dimmed and blocked the chat on load and prevented the ✕ close button from dismissing the drawer), removed the stray "null" text rendered below drawer tabs when no error banner is active, and aligned the collapsed Director pill to the right so it does not overlap Tavo bottom input buttons.
releaseNotes.1_4_0: v1.4.0 «Underworld, Wanted & Relics»: local underworld wallet, debt, loans, collateral and casino games; heat, wanted and faction services; story-only gacha with pity and 12 egg skins; ES256-signed server relic certificates with read-only inventory sync and graceful offline verification. RP state stays isolated from SPINS and paid summon never buys rarity.
releaseNotes.1_4_1: v1.4.1 «Genesis I Relics Live»: embeds the live clodex.xyz ES256 P-256 verification public key (REL_PUBLIC_JWK) so limited-edition Genesis I relics (#0001..#0050 Mythic, #0001..#0100 SSR) minted at clodex.xyz/console/rp-relics sync via /v1/rp/relics/inventory and verify offline in PNG CCv2 cards across Tavo AI and SillyTavern.
releaseNotes.1_4_2: v1.4.2 «Living Companion Care»: companions now react two-way to pure roleplay text with zero extra API calls — feeding, sleeping/resting, or petting/playing in the story updates fullness, energy, bond, and mood automatically alongside button care, while Active Companions context reflects hungry/sleepy/bonded cues back to the AI.
